curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Across a decaying city ravaged by disease, will raw martial skill be enough to run down a lethal predator?
curatedMovie.description: In a plague-ridden future reduced to an urban wasteland, a lone martial artist navigates the ruins on a relentless hunt for a dangerous killer.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, gritty, and suspenseful sci-fi action built around an urgent, high-stakes pursuit.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action-thriller setup follows a lone hunter through a disease-struck future city, keeping the focus on pursuit.
